fact_text: PSO supplies almost half of Pakistan's petrol and diesel demand, which makes it the dominant oil marketing company in the country.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An oil marketing licence requires holding about one month of storage capacity, so a large part of the capital an oil marketer needs is tied up in tanks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGRA requires oil marketers to hold inventory equal to roughly 21 to 25 days of sales at all times, so national fuel supply stays secure.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An oil marketer's total capital need is the cost of building storage plus the working capital needed to fill it with fuel, so its capital base is far larger than its fixed assets alone.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When costing inventory held by an oil marketer, use the ex-refinery price rather than the pump price, because the pump price includes taxes that are paid to government only after the sale.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government sets the oil marketing margin as a fixed rupee amount per litre, so the margin's share of the product price shrinks when refinery prices rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Oil marketers book inventory gains when prices rise between ordering and delivery and inventory losses when prices fall, so reported profit can swing without any change in earning power.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Return on capital for an oil marketer is after-tax profit divided by capital tied up in storage and working capital, so the per-litre margin drives the result.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Higher petroleum prices raise an oil marketer's inventory and borrowing needs while its per-litre margin stays the same, so its return on capital falls even though volumes do not change.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OMC margin increases tend to be delayed when fuel prices are high, because fuel pricing is politically sensitive and the government is unlikely to raise margins during such periods.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Each PKR 1 per litre of OMC margin is worth roughly PKR 8 billion a year to PSO at its annual sales volume of about 8 billion litres, so the margin is the key earnings lever.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst values PSO on normalised earnings that exclude inventory gains and losses, applying a multiple of about 7 to 8 times rather than the reported P/E.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's sum-of-parts method adds PSO's majority stake in Pakistan Refinery Limited to the value of its core marketing and LNG business, so the refinery stake is a separate component of fair value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO's LNG import business earns a fixed gross margin of 2.5% of cargo value set by the government, so its revenue is large but the margin on it is thin.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO must pay its LNG suppliers on time while government payments for gas circular debt are delayed, so its receivables and borrowings build up and the problem is one of cash flow rather than revenue.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A large share of PSO's borrowing funds LNG cargoes, so lower LNG volumes cut finance costs but also cut gross margin, and the two effects partly offset each other.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Circular debt settlement may not produce a large dividend, because PSO would likely use recovered cash first to repay short-term borrowings and settle trade payables.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO borrowed from banks to cover delayed government payments and paid interest on that debt, which strengthens its claim to recover late payment surcharge once circular debt is resolved.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Late payment surcharge on delayed circular-debt payments is not included in PSO's balance sheet because recovery is uncertain, so any partial recovery is value not yet visible in reported numbers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY27 assumption is about 9 billion litres of fuel sales, covering petrol, diesel, high-octane and jet fuel, which together with LNG cargo volumes gives revenue of roughly PKR 3.6 to 3.7 trillion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: On the analyst's FY27 assumptions, gross profit excluding inventory gains and losses is roughly PKR 85 to 95 billion, and operating profit after distribution and admin costs is roughly PKR 60 to 65 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After finance costs and tax, the analyst's FY27 estimate of normalised profit after tax is roughly PKR 20 to 22 billion, with finance cost moving against the LNG gross margin.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A strategic petroleum reserve in a country can give that country first right to buy stored fuel during a supply crisis, and the host country earns the storage rent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Crude oil is usually the product stored in a strategic reserve because it is easier to store than refined petrol and diesel.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A strategic reserve in Pakistan would improve national supply security and reduce shortage risk, but the analyst sees little direct effect on OMC margins or on PSO's earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's research sequence is to understand the business like an owner, then verify the numbers, and only then decide on an investment, taking advice from a financial adviser before acting.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSO Stock Analysis: The One Trigger That Could Change Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)
